examples.en: I skipped breakfast, so I'm hungry now.
I'm hungry. What shall we eat?
The baby is crying because he's hungry.
If you're hungry, have the bread in the fridge.

explain: ‘배고프다’는 ‘배가 고프다’를 줄인 말이에요. 둘 다 써요. ‘ㅡ’가 빠져서 ‘배고파요’가 돼요. 반대말은 ‘배부르다’예요.

dict_examples.en: I'm so hungry I could eat even a rock.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 그는 점심도 먹지 않고 배고픈 것도 잊은 채 눈썰미를 곧추세워 하늘만 뚫어지게 쳐다보았다.
dict_examples.en: Without even eating lunch and forgetting his hunger, he sharpened his eyes and stared intently at the sky.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 배고프다 is a short form of 배가 고프다, and both are used. The ㅡ drops out, so you say 배고파요. The opposite is 배부르다 (full).

examples.en: I want to go to Singapore.
I met a friend at the airport in Singapore.
I went on a trip to Singapore. The food was delicious.

explain: 싱가포르는 도시이면서 나라예요. 끝은 “폴”이 아니라 “포르”로 써요. “싱가폴”은 맞춤법이 틀려요.
explain_en: Singapore is both a city and a country. The ending is spelled “포르”, not “폴”. “싱가폴” is a spelling mistake.
